question: At the qualified R23 exhaustive sixteen-context state, does the antipodal-pair relation law hold across every nonconstant complement-normalized binary partition when the balanced 8/8 restriction is removed?
hypothesis: Across all 32767 nonconstant complement-normalized binary partitions, every one of the 32640 partitions that separates at least one antipodal pair will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate panels, while all 127 nonconstant partitions preserving every antipodal pair will match zero panels; no partition will be partial, and the law will hold in every populated mask-cardinality stratum 1 through 15.

prior_evidence.observation: On all 6435 balanced complement-normalized partitions, all 128 fully separating and all 6272 mixed partitions matched all four panels, while exactly 35 fully preserving partitions matched zero and no partition was partial.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R23 dimension: the popcount-eight balance filter is removed, admitting every nonconstant complement-normalized binary partition. Exhaustive records, complement normalization, antipodal-pair relation, four projections, exact membership comparison, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.r23_replication_control: Run the unchanged local deterministic R23 probe and require its frozen exact trichotomy and cardinalities before R24 output.
arms_and_inputs.exhaustive_state: For each of nine entities and three surface families, include every context_index 0..15 exactly once, yielding 432 records and sixteen records per surface.
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 1..65535 ascending; retain exactly masks with bit zero clear, yielding one representative of each nonconstant complement pair and exactly 32767 partitions.
arms_and_inputs.cardinality_strata: Stratify by mask popcount 1..15; require stratum k to contain exactly C(15,k) partitions and every stratum to be populated.
arms_and_inputs.pair_relation: For each q in 0..7 compare bit(q) with bit(q+8). A partition is pair_preserving only when all eight agree and pair_splitting otherwise.
arms_and_inputs.combinatorial_cardinalities: Require exactly 127 pair-preserving and 32640 pair-splitting partitions. Independently enumerate every nonempty subset of antipodal pairs 1..7, construct pair-union masks, and require its distinct set to equal the 127 pair-preserving masks.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For every retained mask evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], and [bucket,suffix1] against full-five-coordinate membership, exactly 131068 arms in mask then coordinate order.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, pair-relation and cardinality-stratum cardinalities, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.exhaustive_arm: none; every latent context is enumerated exactly once
seeds.r23_control: Exact frozen R23 construction and its inherited R22/R21 controls.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R23 probe must reproduce antipodal_pair_relation_trichotomy_exact, 128 fully-separating all-four matches, 6272 mixed all-four matches, 35 fully-preserving zero matches, no partial match, and zero classification mismatches before R24 output.
The exhaustive full-five-coordinate control must reproduce 432 records, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
Enumeration must yield exactly 32767 distinct nonconstant bit-zero-clear masks, with stratum k equal to C(15,k), partitioned exclusively into 32640 pair-splitting and 127 pair-preserving masks.
An independent enumeration of nonempty subsets of antipodal pairs 1..7 must yield exactly the same 127 pair-preserving masks.
All 131068 arms run once in ascending mask then derived-coordinate order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.

Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.unbalanced_antipodal_law_exact: Validity and controls pass; all 32640 pair-splitting partitions match all four panels, all 127 pair-preserving partitions match zero panels, no partition is partial, classification mismatch count is zero, and every cardinality stratum has zero law mismatches.
classification_rules.balance_necessary_for_some_partitions: Validity and controls pass; at least one pair-splitting partition fails one or more panels.
classification_rules.pair_preservation_not_sufficient_for_fai: Validity and controls pass; at least one pair-preserving partition matches one or more panels.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R23, exhaustive-state, full-five-coordinate, enumeration, cardinality-stratum, normalization, uniqueness, or independent-set control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 131068-arm panel.
